additional_info.subject: Reported issue from customer
additional_info.body:
The charging station (170002836) was out of service for several weeks and
has only been back in use for over a week after the DC fuse was replaced. However, its usability is very limited. Common errors:
- Charging won't start (cable check doesn't work)
- Plug isn't released after charging
- Charging aborted
- And for the past few hours, it hasn't been delivering more than 18 kW in total.
For two vehicles, this is even split.
This is most likely due to the software version. Back in April,
this station was the only one left without an update. Can you
check whether it has been updated today? If so, it probably requires a
second update for it to function normally. It was the same for all the others in April.
